summary: Hesai Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing the record date for its 2026 second extraordinary general meeting (EGM). The EGM is scheduled for August 28, 2026, with a share record date of July 23, 2026. The filing sets forth eligibility requirements for holders of Class A and Class B ordinary shares, as well as ADS holders, to vote and attend the meeting. No transaction, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is announced. This is a routine corporate governance and meeting notice filing without any event meriting a special-situation classification.
